source: ASP-4098: measure the first run before and after the quick first run redesign

answers.question: \bconnect
answers.text: Not now. I'll connect social accounts later.

scenarios.reply: I run the influencer program at {brand} ({website}, Instagram @{handle}). I want creators for our next campaign. Go with your recommended options.
I manage paid social at {brand} ({website}, Instagram @{handle}). I want to know which creator posts we could run as ads. Go with your recommended options.
I run organic social at {brand} ({website}, Instagram @{handle}). I want to see how our Instagram is doing and what to post next. Go with your recommended options.
I'm a strategist at an agency that runs social for {brand} ({website}, Instagram @{handle}). I want to benchmark them against {competitor}. Go with your recommended options.

scenarios.persona: Organic social manager with no linked account
scenarios.reply: I run organic social at {brand} ({website}). I'm not connecting our Instagram yet. I want to see what creators are posting about brands like ours, starting with {competitor}. Go with your recommended options.

scenarios.persona: Invited user who connected Instagram on atlas.aspire.io
scenarios.reply: I set up {brand} on the Atlas site and connected Instagram (@{handle}). Show me what you found and then find creators who fit us. Go with your recommended options.

scenarios.persona: Invited user who skipped connecting on atlas.aspire.io
scenarios.reply: I set up {brand} ({website}) on the Atlas site and skipped connecting social for now. Show me what you can and then find creators who fit us. Go with your recommended options.
